about: ADR 0013 / 0015 / 0018 calibration: per family, summaries (n, min, p5, median, p95, max) of each measure. engineRekey: the new engine (CPU, equal to WebGPU at L1) drawing v21's replayed variation and re-keying its placement stream: per configuration, each of `standIns` draws stands in for v21 against the mean of each measure over the `keys` draws of keys 0..K − 1 (a full re-draw). negativeControls: one structural or pen change per control, drawn with the same K keys, against the first stand-in, with how many applicable configurations the thresholds caught. v21Reroll: v21 at az and az + 0.3° where its stipple re-rolled (a partial re-draw, one draw against one).
